saw_lines: Nobody plans a toothpick purchase. People try one flavor, then stock up when a bundle price makes the choice easy.
So the bundle wins or loses the first order, and new buyers who never see the saving in an ad have no reason to act.
Your site shows more than 100,000 happy customers and a 25% saving on the Powerline Pro Bundle, but your 37 Google text ads carry neither. Lead the next batch with both.
ads_1: Google text ads that open on flavor, then the 25% bundle saving
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, your only linked channels
